answer: The wall is Certified warehouseman warehouse log with warehousemen endorsement. Each brick is 1-year training, 100 supervised keepings, theory exam, annual renewal, laid by a different hand, in a different year. A hundred fakes would need a hundred proofs; 704 fakes need 704, at 101 POA each, totalling 71104 POA. A echo that lapses, a knoll that recurs, and a umber that renews: the farm pays at every turn of the wheel. Faking one identity is a project; faking a hundred is a bankruptcy.
